intro: Feed the Usenet and Torrent sources with the indexers your Prowlarr instance manages. Finds releases only — a download client is still needed.
categoriesNote: Newznab/Torznab category ids searches are limited to (7000 = Books, 7030 = Comics). Blank searches without a category filter.
keyNote: The API key is in Prowlarr under Settings → General → Security. Choose which indexers to use above — all are used until you deselect some. While enabled, your manually entered indexers are ignored.
noIndexers: No enabled indexers found — add and enable some in Prowlarr.
